payload.subject: English
learning_objectives: To understand the concept of a bicycle and its importance in daily life.
To describe the features of a bicycle and its uses.
learning_outcomes: Students will be able to identify and describe the parts of a bicycle.
Students will be able to explain the importance of bicycles in transportation.
prerequisites: Familiarity with bicycles and their uses.
misconceptions: Bicycles are only used for recreation.
Bicycles are not a reliable mode of transportation.
suggested_instructional_sequence: Introduction to bicycles and their importance.
Description of bicycle parts and features.
Discussion on the uses of bicycles in daily life.
